messages:
Tom Alvarez: Heads-up: pricing experiment (BetaDiscount) was supposed to apply 2025-02-01 through 2025-04-30 for select beta customers. Mateo flagged that several March invoices (INV-2025-03-88, INV-2025-03-92) did NOT receive the discount. We need to determine revenue impact and fix before close.

Mateo Ruiz: Confirmed. Billing export shows full list price charged for 6 customers. Total overcharge ~ $18,400 across those invoices. System note: promo code applied only on new invoices, backlog job failed for historical adjustments.

Nora Li: Sales Ops ran the eligibility list. Those accounts were in the Beta cohort but promo flag was set to false on their subscription objects. We manually toggled for new cycles but didn't backfill. My bad.

Priya Kapoor: Quick questions for revrec: were any of these invoices already fully recognized? If yes, credits create an after-the-fact reduction to revenue or an expense (depending on nature).

Tom Alvarez: All invoices posted and recognized pro rata for the March-April period. We'll need to treat this as a billing correction that reduces revenue for the affected periods because the discount was a contractual concession. ASC 606 says reflect the transaction price that we expect to be entitled to.

BillingBot: Invoices INV-2025-03-88 and INV-2025-03-92 marked PAID on 2025-03-05 and 2025-03-07 respectively. Total paid amount: $12,200.

Helen Park: If revenue for March was already recognized, we should post reversing entries and new recognition entries reflecting the lower transaction price. Also need customer credit memos issued to reflect the cash that will be returned or applied.

Mateo Ruiz: Proposed calc: customer A billed $5,000 but should've been $4,200 => $800 credit. For each account: compute delta per invoice line, sum per-account, create credit memo equal to delta, apply to AR or refund if requested.

Priya Kapoor: For GL impact, sample JE to reverse excessive revenue for already-recognized portion:

```
Debit Revenue $X (excess recognized amount)
Credit Accounts Receivable or Cash $X (if refund)
```

Then reduce deferred revenue schedule for remaining periods if the contract price decreased going forward.

Nora Li: Customers prefer account credit in 5/6 cases; 1 requested refund. Mateo can we bulk-create credit memos and set apply method?

Mateo Ruiz: Yes, Billing can generate credit memos. We'll set AutoApply for those choosing credit, refund for the one preferring payout. Need decision in 24 hours to hit month-end.

Tom Alvarez: Action plan: 1) Mateo create credit memos and update AR, 2) Priya prepare adjusting revenue JEs for recognized amounts and update deferral schedule for remaining periods, 3) Nora confirm customer preferred disposition and attach email consents, 4) Victor open eng ticket to backfill promo flag for past cycles and prevent future misses.

Victor Nguyen: I'll open ENG-1129 to run the backfill job and a post-deploy validation. Will include a dry-run and checksum. ETA 3 business days.

Priya Kapoor: I'll post sample adjusting JE for one account after Mateo uploads the per-account deltas. Need Helen's sign-off before posting.

Helen Park: Approve contingent on attach of customer consent for credit vs refund and the per-account delta worksheet. Also want the audit worksheet showing original JE and proposed reversing entries.

Mateo Ruiz: Uploaded worksheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/FAKE_BETADISCOUNT (rows for INV-2025-03-88 etc)

Nora Li: Pasted customer choices: Account1: credit, Account2: credit, Account3: refund, Account4: credit, Account5: credit, Account6: credit.

Tom Alvarez: Priya once you have the JE draft I can route to Helen. Timeline: need posted adjustments by EOD two business days to meet May close.

Priya Kapoor: Draft JE for INV-2025-03-88 (example):
```
2025-05-15 Debit Revenue $560.00
            Credit Accounts Receivable $560.00  (Customer A share of excess recognized)
2025-05-15 Debit Deferred Revenue $240.00
            Credit Revenue $240.00  (reduce remaining schedule)
```

Tom Alvarez: Looks good. Two notes: include memo referencing promo code BetaDiscount and invoice IDs. Also attach Sales Ops verification.

Mateo Ruiz: Will issue credit memos today and set refund for Account3. Also will tag NetSuite records with "beta_reprice_adjust" for audit.

Victor Nguyen: ENG-1129 created and assigned to @eng-billing. Linking ticket to this thread.

Helen Park: Once JE posted, please upload NetSuite JE screenshots and the audit worksheet. We'll include in month-end package.

Tom Alvarez: Thanks team. Also let's add a billing rule: if promo flag toggled after invoice generation, run a nightly backfill check for prior 90 days and surface exceptions to Sales Ops. @Victor or Mateo can we make that a follow-up?

Mateo Ruiz: Agree. I'll coordinate with Victor on the scope.

Priya Kapoor: Closing note  track adjustments in month-end tracker and label as "BetaDiscount retro credits".

Nora Li: I'll email customers confirming credits/refunds today.

Tom Alvarez: Closing thread once NetSuite JEs are posted and audit confirms. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
